candidate_scenarios.scene: A flooded astronomical tower stairwell, with a missing stair span above dark water. An explorer chooses ROOTBRIDGE instead of FLAME DART or GLASS SKIN; living roots grow from her chosen card to reconnect the near stair and far landing, and her forward boot tests the new crossing. A two-charge spell meter falls to one.

An abandoned salt-mine dungeon where a sound-reactive bronze sentinel guards the exit. An explorer plays ECHO STEP from a three-card hand; an illusory footstep rings on the left passage while she slips through the unguarded right route, visible energy counter exhausted.

An overgrown greenhouse dungeon where acid rain eats the path. An explorer selects MOSS SHIELD from a three-branch evolution display; a living moss mantle spreads from wrist to an arch overhead and bends the acid stream away from a fragile seedling she must carry.

A fractured clocktower dungeon with a jammed pendulum over an abyss. An explorer selects MAGNETIC RECALL from three skill cards; a separated iron key flies visibly toward her wrist and pulls a locking pin from the gate, releasing the passage.

initial_comparison: The bridge choice has the clearest directly visible cause and both endpoints. Echo-step emphasizes tactical diversion but sound is difficult to verify. Moss evolution has an ecological consequence but a busy branch interface. Magnetic recall has an object trajectory but risks ambiguous causation. The random selection governs subject matter; open staging will make that selected relation visible.
